main-window.description: The shipped meeting-notes window may run one local meeting flow: check readiness, request the two capture permissions, start and stop a meeting, name a meeting, edit an operator note, copy a transcript, manage exact local vocabulary replacements without rewriting retained transcript bytes, correct a displayed speaker name without rewriting the retained transcript, restore a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, compare a source-bound retry candidate and either keep the current transcript or promote that candidate, open only the verified transcript file the operator selected, play only a freshly verified retained microphone or system recording through a fixed native player, release a selected recording, delete a confirmed transcript and its generated notes, delete a confirmed meeting, open local completed notes with retained source passages, regenerate a meeting note from its current transcript, and receive the local note-capture-hotkey focus event while a meeting is recording. It cannot use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

preview-window.description: The local Preview build exercises the same meeting-notes flow as the shipped window, including naming a meeting, editable personal notes, exact local vocabulary replacements without rewriting retained transcript bytes, bounded speaker-name correction, restoring a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, comparing a source-bound retry candidate and selecting it only through the durable retry authority, only the freshly verified retained microphone or system recording selected by an opaque handle, confirmed recording, transcript, or whole-meeting deletion, regenerating a meeting note from its current transcript, and receiving the local note-capture-hotkey focus event while a meeting is recording. It has no reference-interface, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

settings-window.description: The Settings window may show and request the two local capture permissions, show the signed speech-model and note-model catalogs, install and activate catalog models, remove an inactive speech model, and remove the note model. It cannot read meetings or use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.
